correctness.rationale: An exact cap condition and normalized spherical dot-product density give the starting law. Uniform integration-by-parts cap bounds and a unique global saddle produce the exact exponential base 16/27, the prefactor 27 sqrt(6)/(16 sqrt(pi d)) and relative \(O(d^{-1})\) remainder. Conditional Laplace convergence gives variance \(16/27\) on \(\sqrt d\) scale, and a perpendicular spherical-coordinate variance bound gives all three limiting dot products. Symbolic identities and finite quadratures were independently replayed; they supplement rather than replace the analytic steps.
